name: kandev
description: AI Kanban & Development Environment. Orchestrate multiple agents, review changes, open PRs. Multi-provider, self-hostable, no telemetry.

issues.title: [Bug]: macOS desktop web view pegs a CPU core and grows to ~4.5 GB after days of uptime; kandev-desktop leaves zombie children
[Bug]: Windows Defender quarantines the unsigned agentctl.exe, and the running backend never says why
[Feature]: Mark a rate-limited model unavailable and fall back
[Feature]: Per-event Apprise notification title/body templates with safe destination variables
[Feature]: Sandbox providers for Local/Worktree executors (nono as first provider) with per-step/task profile selection and session-end learning
[Feature]: SSH executor worktree materialization from a per-host repository cache or an existing remote checkout
[Bug]: OpenCode V2 credentials are not provisioned by Copy auth files

latest_release.name: v0.101.0
latest_release.body:
> [!WARNING]
> macOS, Windows desktop installers in this release are unsigned development builds.
> They may require manual OS security bypasses and are not trusted downloads.
>
> If macOS blocks Kandev after you verify the checksum, run:
>
> ```bash
> xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Kandev.app
> ```
